description: Shop for Dakota's Pride Dry Great Northern Beans. This package of dried beans is perfect to have on hand for your favorite soup or chili recipes. Discover all of our bean options at affordable prices when you shop with us.

name: Instant White Rice, 28 oz
description: In a rush? Had a long day? Don't want the fuss when it comes to cooking regular rice? Pick up a box of Earthly Grains Instant White Rice at ALDI. This enriched white rice cooks in 5 minutes, a fifth of the time it takes to make regular rice. Not only will this rice take no time at all to cook, it's gluten free, cholesterol free, and microwaveable. You can reap the benefits of this better-for-you rice as well as put it in the microwave instead of cooking it on a stovetop. Discover even more quality and affordable pantry products like rice, pasta, and grains when you shop at ALDI.

name: Organic Spaghetti, 1 lb
description: No pantry is complete without this Simply Nature Organic Spaghetti! The non-GMO spaghetti noodles are made with organic durum wheat semolina for the perfect taste and texture. Team yours with tangy marinara sauce, hearty meatballs, and a sprinkle of fresh parmesan for a classic homemade Italian dinner!

name: Organic Linguine, 1 lb
description: This Simply Nature Organic Linguine is sure to become your new pantry essential! The non-GMO linguine noodles are made with organic durum wheat semolina for a perfectly tender bite every time. Enjoy yours with fresh seafood, a light carbonara sauce, and a sprinkle of freshly cut herbs for a delicious and filling dinner!

name: Angel Hair Pasta, 32 oz
description: Shop for Reggano Angel Hair Pasta from ALDI. Swap out traditional spaghetti noodles with these thin \"angel hair\" style noodles. They pair with nearly any pasta dish and even in stir fry or vegetable bowls. Simply toss in your favorite sauce and add protein and vegetables for a filling and healthy meal option. However you choose to enjoy, shop at ALDI for our Reggano Angel Hair Pasta at an affordable price. Discover all of our delicious pasta options when you stop in.

name: Rotini Pasta, 16 oz
description: This Reggano Rotini Pasta is an absolute pantry essential! Made from durum semolina, the rotini noodles are low fat, sodium free, and cholesterol free. Team yours with a tomato-based red sauce, hearty sausage, and a sprinkle of fresh herbs for the perfect dinner!

name: Original Long Grain & Wild Rice Mix, 6 oz
description: Make tonight's dinner a breeze with this Earthly Grains Original Long Grain & Wild Rice Mix! The boxed mix features fluffy long grain rice, hearty wild rice, and fresh herbs for a tasty bite every time. Top yours with a juicy chicken breast or a tender salmon filet for the perfect meal!

name: Elbow Macaroni, 32 oz
description: Reggano Elbow Macaroni Noodles from ALDI aren't only for macaroni and cheese. These curved-shaped noodles are delicious in cold pasta salads, with your favorite meat sauce, or even in soups. Most famously known for their role in delicious mac and cheese, try adding melted cheese sauce to cooked noodles for a familiar and savory taste. Shop today for a 32 oz box of Macaroni Noodles for whichever recipe you are making.

name: Organic Quinoa, 16 oz
description: Bring home the super grain of the Andes with our organic quinoa. Simply Nature quinoa is a zero sodium food, naturally gluten free, and a good source of fiber. It's also non-GMO and only has 0g of total sugars per serving. Looking for meal inspiration? Use Simply Nature Organic Quinoa to make a delicious avocado and quinoa salad, quinoa burger patties, a bowl of porridge, and so much more. Stop by an ALDI near you to discover all of our affordable pantry products.

name: Roasted Vegetable and Chicken Long Grain & Wild Rice Mix, 6.3 oz
description: Add a burst of flavor to any dinner plate with this Earthly Grains Roasted Vegetable and Chicken Long Grain & Wild Rice Mix! The mix features fluffy long grain rice and hearty wild rice that's packed with fresh chicken flavor. Team yours with steamed veggies and a squeeze of lemon juice for the perfect side dish!

name: Parboiled Long Grain Rice, 5 lb
description: Make the heart-healthy choice with this bag of Earthly Grains Parboiled Long Grain Rice. The gluten free parboiled rice is packed with iron and vital nutrients to give any dish an extra boost of nutrition. Cook up yours to make delicious rice pilafs, casseroles, or loaded rice bowls.

name: Swabian Egg Noodles Spaetzle, 17.6 oz
description: Put a fresh twist on your favorite pasta dish with this Deutsche Küche Egg Spaetzle! Following an authentic German recipe, the Swabian egg noodles are made with fresh semolina and have a mild flavor. Go classic by pairing yours with tender meat and savory gravy, or switch it up by teaming the noodles with a creamy cheese sauce.
